records.statement: Nominal logistic regression is used when a categorical response has three or more categories with no natural ordering among the levels.
records.section: Lesson 13.2: Logistic Regression; 13.2.1 Nominal Logistic Regression

records.statement: Ordinal logistic regression is used when a categorical response has three or more categories with a natural ordering, and the ordering does not imply equal intervals between adjacent levels.
records.section: Lesson 13.2: Logistic Regression; 13.2.2 Ordinal Logistic Regression
